batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: st DH Yagnik b SK Warne

batting.name: RV Gomez
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b SK Trivedi

batting.name: NLTC Perera
batting.dismissal: c STR Binny b SK Trivedi

batting.name: KM Jadhav
batting.dismissal: c DH Yagnik b SK Trivedi

batting.name: R Vinay Kumar
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b A Singh

balls.text: another heave, RP gets it away towards deep midwicket, Murali was sprinting for two, RP wasn't, he was casually sauntering, and the throw from Botha catches him short, Kochi are bowled out for 109, Rajasthan will be thrilled with this
outside off, and Trivedi gets a third wicket, nicked to the keeper, Jadhav's troubled stay is over

another attempted heave, another miss, this time the batsman is hit above the waist, Murali was more than halfway through for a single, batsman was in no position to attempt the run, Murali turns back, he had given up actually, but the bowlers throw misses
Murali looks to swipe the ball towards midwicket, misses the ball, but they run through for a bye
bangs in a bouncer to the No. 10, Murali can't get near it
heaved behind square leg for a single
shortish and outside leg, batsmen have decided to move beyond leg every ball, helped along to third man
length ball heading for legstump, batsman skips away from leg again, jabbed behind point
backs away and swipes it to the leg side for a single
makes room and chops the ball towards mid-off
another short ball, outside off again, batsman can't get bat on it, that was a no-ball due to some breach of the fielding restrictions, not sure what though
Watson slips in the bouncer, batsman ducks at the last moment
Murali gets off the mark by guiding the ball towards third man

Kochi doing a house-of-cards impersonation, batsman looks to cheekily dab the ball past short third man, hits it in the air to Watson fielding there, that's the fifth wicket in little more than two overs
short of length ball heading for off, defended down the pitch
well outside off, superbly timed by Vinay off the back foot, carves it through cover for four
a mistimed punch towards mid-on for a single
clipped towards midwicket for a single

and that's another one down for Kochi, a superb catch from Binny, Perera becomes another batsman holing out attempting a big hit, he can't get the distance either and Binny falls forward as he takes a low catch
just outside off, nudged in front of square leg for a single
inside-edge as the batsman looks to drive, bounces through to the keeper
defended back to the bowler this time
short of length and just outside off, Perera opens the face and guides the ball towards backward point and zips through for a single

Kochi are crumbling, a length ball from Trivedi, Gomes wants to smash that over long-on, can't connect as well as he wants, and finds Watson waiting at long-on, Rajasthan get their sixth wicket, and it seems there will be no late onslaught
a fantastic spell comes to an end, as the batsman survives a loud lbw appeal
no hat-trick for Warne, solidly defended by Perera
Parthiv unwisely attempts the reverse-sweep after coming out of the crease, he doesn't connect, the keeper collects and Yagnik removes the bails in a jiffy, Parthiv's fighting cameo is over
Jadeja holes out, he was looking send the ball into orbit, sweeps hard at a length ball, top-edges it and Warne back-pedals to take a looping catch
Parthiv can't time it as he looks to smash the ball towards extra cover, ball keeps low and rolls towards cover
Jadeja down the track, but Warne fires it in short, nicked towards short third man
an unseemly flat-batted hit towards long-on, very good running from Kochi, scamper back for the second
cramps the batsman up by angling into the pads, defended off the back foot to the left of the bowler for a single
width on offer for Jadeja, who steadies himself and powerfully crunches it past point for four, well done by Jadeja
slashed towards sweeper cover for a single
Parthiv looks to whip that after shuffling across, off the pads towards the bowler, Jadeja had scrambled out for a single, has to turn back and a direct hit from Watson would have made it interesting
skates out of the crease and lashes the ball towards mid-off, where the fielder moves across smartly to field
on the pads, once more the batsman tucks it wide of short fine for a single, end of a good effort from Botha
whips the ball towards short fine for a single
full and fired into the pads, driven towards the mid-on
just outside off, dabbed towards short third man and a quick single is sprinted
length ball just outside off, eased towards long-off for a single
length ball outside off, inside-edged on to the pads
the Trivedi slower ball makes its appearance, batsman wanted to send that out of the stadium but it sneaks under his bat
short ball on legstump, another pull from Jadeja, this time he can't beat deep square leg
Jadeja unleashes another effortful pull, this time he has the placement to match, beats the diving Amit Singh at deep midwicket to pick up a boundary
length ball on off, hit hard by Jadeja but can't beat extra cover, he hasn't been anywhere as fluent as Parthiv today
short of length ball on middle, makes a bit of room and drives towards cover, where Warne dives to stop it
short ball down the leg side, attempts a powerful pull, gloved towards short fine
swept fine by Pathiv this time after the batsman leaned across to off
a lot of effort from Jadeja for a single, swept hard to deep midwicket
quicker on middle and off, turned towards midwicket, not wide enough of the fielder to take a single
worked past midwicket for an ambled single
goes straight on, pushed off the back foot past the bowler
too full from Warne, well outside off, swept firmly by Parthiv
nifty shot from Parthiv, opens the face to guide the ball towards third man
nicely done by Parthiv, stays back and short arm pulls that leg stump ball behind square leg for four, superbly placed by Parthiv to beat fine leg and deep backward square leg
length ball on off, eased towards long-on for a single
on a length on middle and off, punched off the back foot towards wide long-on
short of length ball, driven on the up off the front foot towards the bowler
whipped off the pads towards fine leg
driven off the backfoot past cover
outside off and off the pad before it edges towards the vacant slip
driven down to long-on for a single
backs away and lashes it towards extra cover, no timing at all on that shot, fifty finally comes up for Kochi
overpitched by Warne, and the sweep connects this time, down towards deep backward square leg
flighted and way outside off, looks for the sweep but doesn't connect
thumped down to long-on for a single
full and outside off, eased towards mid-off
heaved towards midwicket by Parthiv off the back foot
launched over the bowler's head by Parthiv, once again the ball doesn't go all the way, Trivedi runs around from long-off
massive appeal from Botha, might have hit outside off, as Parthiv looked to defend
watchful forward defense from Parthiv
outside off, and goes straight on, blocked by Jadeja
is that a bouncer from a legspinner? it was a medium-pacer's delivery that, 109kmh, short and just outside leg, Jadeja ducks

Instant impact from Warne, pitched on middle and scooted low, spun just past off, Hodge backed away and  looked to slash that through cove, gets a bottom-edge and drags it on to the stumps, Rajasthan in charge here
swept fine by the batsman, Amit Singh puts in a dive at fine leg
on target right away, on legstump inside-edged
once again on the pads, nudged behind square leg for a single
down the leg side
length ball on the pads, punched past the bowler, some confusion where to go for the run before they decide not to
punched towards deep point for a single
ugly but effective from Parthiv, swiped from outside off past a diving midwicket for four, there was no one in the deep in that area and Parthiv capitalised
that one skids on, gets the inside-edge as Parthiv looks to defend and runs away towards leg slip
whipped off the pads past midwicket, the call is for two, but the batsman realise there isn't time to come back for the second
well outside off, jabbed towards backward point for a tight single
goes for the big hit over extra cover, doesn't time it too well, ball clears the infield but doesn't go all the way, Hodge a bit early through the shot
looks to tuck this towards square leg but can't time it, the ball dribbles to the leg side
short of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot towards cover
full ball into middle and leg, blocked to the off side by Hodge
defended towards the off side
Parthiv gets forward and looks to defend, the ball bounces more than he expects and he takes his bottom hand off the bat as he plays to control the ball
once more Parthiv gives backward point fielding practice
bit of width, Parthiv rocks back and slashes it towards backward point
Parthiv slaps this one towards cover
Hodge gets off the mark by tucking the ball to leg

amidthe talk about whether he's worth the big money, Botha strikes first ball, getting the massive wicket of Jayawardene, it was pitching on middle and going on with the angle, Jayawardene moved across and wanted to play it towards fine leg, it takes the thigh pad and rolls on to the stumps, a trifle unlucky there the batsman, hit the bottom of the thigh pad
this one ducks in towards Jayawardene, once more he's not at ease playing it, edged towards the leg side
length ball on middle and leg, whipped behind square leg by Parthiv to get off the mark
Parthiv's first ball elicits a big appeal for lbw, it jags into the pads, but that was sliding down

Laxman is gone, run-out by Dravid, Jayawardene can't connect anywhere as well this time to a fullish ball, which dribbles towards backward point, a tight single is called for, never a good thing when Laxman is in the middle, Dravid gets a direct hit that catches Laxman more than a yard short
bu-bye, that was overpitched by Watson just outside off, Jayawardene sledge-hammers that one to the bowler's left for four
swish and a miss outside off, loads of width provided by Watson, but batsman can't connect
ends the over with a superb ball, follows the batsman who was looking to back away, hit in the handle as he looks to avoid that shortish ball, which lobs towards short third man
looks to drive this one and gets a bit of an outside edge past the keeper, and down to third man
length ball on middle, glanced down to fine leg for a single by Jayawardene
lovely to watch, Jayawardene rocks back and carves the ball behind backward point for four, he played that shot so well in the World Cup final too
down the leg side
inside-edged towards square leg for a single, an ugly Laxman Twenty20 shot, looking to power the ball after charging down
gets forward and drive a ball that is well outside off, firmly hit and Warne dives to stop that one and seems to have hurt his fingers in the effort, nothing serious hopefully
length ball outside off, pushed towards mid-off to end the over, good one from Watson
Jayawardene gives the charge, it was a shortish ball from Watson, Jayawardene was nowhere near the pitch, and his attempted slash doesn't connect
beaten as he looks to glide the ball through the off side, that kept a touch low from Watson, this is a slow track, one reason why Tait is sidelined
a hint of away movement for Watson after the ball pitched on a length outside off
well outside off, length delivery, Jayawardene plays it late, opens the face to guide the ball towards third man
starts with a ball on legstump, worked towards midwicket
width on offer for VVS, he doesn't move his feet as he slashes the ball towards backward point
driven on the up by Laxman, beautifully timed, he gets well forward and square drives that over point for four more
Amit loses his line, down the leg side, off the thigh pad and past the diving keeper for four leg byes
fullish ball, no room for VVS, pushed towards mid-off
keeps it short of length and around off, defended by VVS
Amit's first ball is short of a length outside off, guided to third man by Mahela
another reverse-sweeps seals the victory, Rajasthan  vaults into second spot, that was a thoroughly dominant performance from them, Kochi's winning streak comes to an end
gets forward and drives towards long-off to pick off a couple
no half-century for Watson, he looked to work a fullish ball towards the leg side, it was flat and fired in, Watson misses and legstump is on the ground, Jadeja enjoys the moment
brutality from Watson, he moves on to 49 with a muscled hit down the ground, much too quick for long-on or long-off to do anything about it
skips away from leg and guides the ball to short third man
worked to short fine leg for a single
more awful fielding, Botha brings out the reverse-sweep, powers a full toss past the fielder at backward point, he should have stopped that one and conceded at most a single
rocks back and carves that past point to end the over
another six from Watson, this game is getting over in a hurry, the Rajasthan crowd are delighted, this time Watto swats it to cow corner for a six that just about clears the ropes
big lbw from Murali after Watson is struck on the pads, that was going down, Murali was hopping up and down as he appealed furiously
finally the first of the sixes the crowd came to see from Watson, who gets a massive stride and slugs that one over long-on for a huge six
Watson goes down on one knee, and swipes the ball to deep square leg
cut back in from a length, batsman is caught on the crease but he manages to stab it well wide of the keeper
heaved towards deep midwicket for a single this time
thumped towards deep midwicket by Watson, a dive from Hodge stops the ball from going for four
length ball on offstump, defended towards short cover
short and outside off, slammed towards deep midwicket by Botha
short ball from Vinay to start a new spell, Watson was in position to play the pull early but it was a slower ball, it was a top edge from Watson, takes the ball down to fine leg
length ball just outside off, dropped towards off, batsman sets off for a single before being asked to turn back by Watson
fullish ball on middle and off, defended to the off side

more width outside off, Dravid eases the ball towards third man, sprints back for the second, but the throw from the deep was right on top of the stumps and Dravid is caught short by inches as the keeper takes off the bails
just outside off, dabbed towards short third man
length ball on middle and leg, driven towards mid-on by Dravid
length ball outside off, opens the face to guide the ball towards point
driven firmly but can;t beat short cover
looks to sweep this one from well outside off, misses
Jadeja shouts 'Cacth it' but that was a brutal hit from Watson, powered past long-off for four
tucked to short fine leg for a single
of all the big-hitters and T20 specialists in the match, it is Dravid who brings ou the first six of the day, slammed over long-on by Dravid, not the most elegant but it will do
fullish ball is defended to the off side

Kochi are putting in a terrible display in the field, Watson clobbers the ball down the ground to long-on, RP Singh has a regulation stop to make and he lets it through his hands for a boundary, Kochi already thinking of the flight out of Jaipur?
short of length ball that one keeps low, Dravid adjusts and drives for a single
length ball is driven past cover for a single
dabbed towards backward point
powered towards short cover by Watson, a diving stop by the fielder there
driven to long-off for a single

dropped Jadeja is having a poor day in the field, puts down the danger man Watson, who clubbed the ball back to the bowler, was a low chance but Jadeja is  usually a reliable fielder, he can't latch on this time, nice catch-able height too that was
length ball outside off, Dravid stretches across and drives towards cover
Watson thumps that down to long-on, all along the ground for a single
slapped off the back foot towards backward point
full ball just outside off, driven towards extra cover
Jadeja is on as Kochi looks for wickets, Watson is beaten outside off by the turn, big appeal for a stumping, Watson's back foot is firmly planted in the crease
outside off, Watson opens the face to send the ball towards backward point
on the pads again, pushed wide of mid-on, Watson was very keen on a second, 'No no no no no,' is the desperate call from Dravid, and Watson hurries back after starting for the second
Perera replies with the fast bowlers' fallback, the bouncer, Dravid ducks

what a shot this is from Dravid, superb to watch, gets back and clips the ball off the back foot, waits for the ball and uses his wrists to send the ball scurrying to the midwicket boundary, top shot that
short of length ball on the pads, pushed towards mid-on for a single
glides the ball towards third man
Watson guides the doosra towards point to end the over
the straighter one from Murali, Watson playing for the turn, the ball zips past the outside edge
gets off the strike with a single to the off side
this time it is very convincing from Dravid, a touch short, Dravid skips towards leg and whips the ball past mid-on for four, slightly airy but well wide of the fielder
arches back and carves the ball towards point
Dravid wants to drive that through off, mistimes it towards the bowler
another top-edge for Dravid, lands well short of third man, and Dravid collects a single
blocked to the off side after moving towards leg

oh dear! Kochi can't afford these overthrows, length ball just outside off, driven to backward point, Jadeja thinks he has spotted the non-striker out of the crease. and shies at the stumps, he misses and the ball goes away for four free runs
short of length ball outside off, jags in a touch and Dravid is surprised by that one, can't connect
Dravid brings out the pull, and like most batsmen today he struggles with the big shot, the short ball hurries on and Dravid gets a top edge, flies over short fine leg for a one-bounce four
inside-edges the ball towards midwicket by Watson
Dravid can't get hold of it as he looks to whip it to midwicket, ball rolls on to the pitch
just down the leg side
Dravid looks to guide the ball to third man but is beaten outside off
blocked to the off side by Dravid
dabbed off the pads towards midwicket for an ambled single
tossed up on a length just outside off, worked towards square leg
speared down the leg side
length ball on the pads, flicked away to deep backward square leg
Watson looks to defend a short of length ball on the front foot, edged and onto the pads, ball dribbles towards the keeper
length ball outside leg, off the pads towards square leg
not much room for Watson to work with, he still manages to dab the ball to third man for a single
looks to squeeze this one past the keeper, but can't get it past
tested with the short ball, Watson mistimes his pull, the ball rolls towards mid-on
short of length and outside off, Dravid looks to guide that to third man but is beaten
classy from Dravid, overpitched by his state team-mate, and Dravid unleashes an on-drive and gets the placement perfect
Watson surprised by the 134kmh bouncer, came quicker on to Watson than he expected, was half way through his pull when the ball struck the bat, off the top edge and loops over square leg,
looks to whip it to the leg side, flies away off the edge towards backward point
length ball outside off, carefully defended by Dravid
on the pads, easy runs for Dravid, played along the ground to deep midwicket
clipped off the pads behind square leg for a single, good start for Rajasthan
length ball on middle and off, played towards the off side by Watson, hesitates before taking a single
pulled to backward square leg by Watson, hit hard into the ground
back of a length on middle and leg, clipped behind square leg by Dravid for a single
opens the face to guide the ball to third man
what a start to the innings, width for Watson, he crunches that off the backfoot in front of point for four, hammered that one
